implementation: Pitney Bowes PC Meter Cryptographic Module
description: The PC Meter Cryptographic Module consists of a single IC - an SGS Thompson ST16CF54A. The interface to the IC is a serial interface which conforms to the ISO/IEC 7816-3 smart card standard. The module provides security services to support the secure accounting and cryptographic functions required to implement the USPS (U.S. Postal Service) IBIP (Information Based Indicia Program).
